n1.speaker: priya
n1.text: Hi there. How can I help?

branches.suggestion: I bought this kettle two weeks ago and it's stopped working.
branches.suggestionFa: دو هفته پیش این کتری را خریدم و از کار افتاده.

branches.suggestion: I'd like to return this. It's faulty.

n2.speaker: priya
n2.text: Oh no. Have you got the receipt? Without one, I can only offer a credit note, I'm afraid.

translations.fa: ای وای. رسید دارید؟ بدون رسید، متأسفانه فقط می‌تونم کارت اعتبار خرید بدم.

branches.suggestion: Here's the receipt. I paid by card, too.
branches.suggestionFa: اینم رسید. با کارت هم پرداخت کردم.

branches.suggestion: I've got the bank statement, if that helps.
branches.suggestionFa: صورت‌حساب بانکی دارم، اگه کمک می‌کنه.

n3.speaker: priya
n3.text: That's perfect. So would you like a replacement or a refund?

translations.fa: عالیه. پس تعویض می‌خواید یا بازپرداخت؟

branches.suggestion: A full refund, please. I don't trust this model any more.
branches.suggestionFa: بازپرداخت کامل لطفاً. دیگه به این مدل اعتماد ندارم.

branches.suggestion: A replacement is fine, as long as it's a different model.
branches.suggestionFa: تعویض خوبه، به شرطی که مدل دیگه‌ای باشه.

cultureNote.en: Under the UK Consumer Rights Act, you're entitled to a full refund if a product is faulty within 30 days of purchase.
cultureNote.fa: تا ۳۰ روز برای کالای معیوب حق بازپرداخت کامل دارید.

n4.speaker: priya
n4.text: No problem — within thirty days you're entitled to a full refund anyway. I'll just need to check it's not been damaged. Did it get dropped at all?

translations.fa: مشکلی نیست — در هر صورت تا سی روز حق بازپرداخت کامل دارید. فقط باید چک کنم آسیب ندیده باشه. اصلاً افتاده؟

branches.suggestion: No, it just stopped heating one morning.
branches.suggestionFa: نه، فقط یه روز صبح دیگه گرم نکرد.

branches.suggestion: Not at all. I've used it carefully.
branches.suggestionFa: اصلاً. با دقت ازش استفاده کردم.

n5.speaker: priya
n5.text: Looks like the element has gone. That's a manufacturing fault. Refund's gone back on your card — three to five days. Sorry for the hassle!

translations.fa: به نظر میاد المنتش سوخته. این عیب تولیده. بازپرداخت به کارتتون برگشت — سه تا پنج روز. ببخشید بابت دردسر!
